title: Fixture: Early Tencent Article English Backfill Sample
summary: Pilot fixture for site-first English backfill ingest validation.
author: Unique Research
html:
This is a deterministic fixture article used to verify the English backfill import path without touching production content or Substack discovery.

It contains enough plain text to satisfy the minimum full-text threshold for catalog inclusion and uses only safe HTML tags.

Operations teams replace fixture packages with editor-reviewed English JSON before a real backfill batch ships.
